items.title: Delhi Protests: Supreme Court issues notice to Centre on pleas against police clampdown; orders preservation of videos
items.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday issued notices to the Union government and Delhi Police on a batch of petitions concerning the recent Delhi protests – alleged police excesses, restrictions on public movement and de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest site. A bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi directed law enforcement agencies to preserve CCTV footage and other recordings relating to the protests. "All law enforcement agencies are directed to preserve the CCTV footage or any other digital material collected by them. Similarly, such material collected by private parties, they shall also be at liberty to preserve," the Court said.
